passage:
For the town festival, each class made one lantern. Most lanterns were shaped like animals or flowers.
Class 809 made a plain white lantern with many small windows cut into it. Inside, they placed drawings of people in the town: shop owners, bus drivers, teachers, farmers, and students.
At night, light shone through the windows and made the drawings appear on the ground.
Visitors stopped to look. The lantern was simple from far away, but full of details up close.
The class explained that a town is like a lantern. Buildings are the outside shape, but people are the light inside.
Their lantern did not win first prize, but many visitors remembered it.
